persons\[someone\].Properties.residence.Value: cannot parse.*reference value: using string value
-- test.glx --
persons:
  someone:
    properties:
      # residence has a "places" reference_type, and so requires a string.
      residence: true
-- want-catalog.yaml --
persons:
  someone:
    properties:
      residence:
        definition:
          label: Residence
          reference_type: places
        values:
            # TODO(spec): This is the wrong thing to do. Better to drop the
            # value and consequently the property.
          - value: StringValue{"true"}
